verdict.rationale: a-Shell is a Unix-like terminal with scripting languages (Python, Lua, JS) and file commands for moving, compressing and processing files, so bulk work across many files is achievable through scripts. Apple Shortcuts integration also allows complex multi-step file-processing workflows. However, no evidence explicitly documents batch or bulk operations, such as globbing, loops over many items, or multi-file selection, and nothing ties this to AI-driven workflows. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of bulk/batch operations across many items, AI-agent-driven bulk execution, independent or hands-on corroboration.
